original_question: List every TR that affected TS 38.211 and its impact type (revision history of 38.211).
original_query: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.211'})<-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]-(ti:TRImpact)<-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]-(tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ti.impactType, ti.affectedSection, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY tr.trNumber

evidence.finding: The original TR/type history question is linked to 29 original XML/style pairs, all 26 retained TRs, eleven independent SQL roles and complete own-role graph incidence. The records distinguish declared impact labels, study findings and implementation CRs while preserving the original answer roles and full source context.
evidence.counterauthority: Both seven-unit reviews preserve the original EN/KR author context, complete target-spec inverse query, declared mapping, original scope and conclusions, typed study-WI routes, 28 naming candidates and 595 CR/section projection rows with their distinct evidentiary roles.
